CATML Workbench — third-party license texts
==========================================

This directory contains the full license texts for JavaScript libraries and
fonts redistributed with the CATML Workbench UI.

See also:
  - THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md (repository root / dist-info/licenses/)
  - ../VERSIONS.txt (pinned component versions)

Files:
  chartjs-MIT.txt
  lucide-ISC.txt          (ISC + Feather MIT notice)
  tailwindcss-MIT.txt
  geist-OFL-1.1.txt
  ibm-plex-OFL-1.1.txt
